notes_for_editor: Strongest of the three, but it rests on one detailed source: a Koochiching County towers PDF on Wikimedia Commons. The text we read does not name its author or date. Its survey notes give 1930, a 94-ft ladder tower, state number 83, and removed; the FFLA list agrees on gone. The record coordinates match the PDF's (47.8759, -93.8312). No removal year and no staffing are given, so the event list has only the 1930 build. The PDF says the buildings went to the Northome forestry station; that station's own history was not read and is the best lead for a fuller fate. Nothing we read describes the site today or public access, so access is omitted. Suggested check: Northome forestry station history, or a dated site visit by someone with landowner permission.
